frozen_before: reference-runtime collection, fresh-cache delivery and product-default-mode runs
authority: Maintainer instruction of 2026-10-05 approving the release scope, the pinned MLX-VLM reference, a fresh-cache delivery download and drafted memory/cold-start bounds.
release_scope: Direct decoding is the default product path; model MTP stays an explicit, experimental opt-in (--mlx-mtp-policy required). MTP-S, MTP-P and MTP-D are not promoted and no MTP speedup is claimed.

target.host: MacBook Pro, Apple M5 Max, 128 GB unified memory, internal SSD; single-stream resident (--max-concurrent-requests 1, MTP off for the default path, contexts up to 32k)
target.kv_pool: --total-blocks 4096 (65,536 tokens) for the long-context lookup; the 16,384-token default pool is documented, not changed

memory.basis: ADR-049 (2026-10-23) moved the standard host to the 128 GB MacBook Pro M5 Max and kept the 96 GiB bound: 75% of 128 GiB, about 20 GiB above the observed single peaks of 73.1 and 76.2 GiB over the 105-item cohort. The earlier basis was half of the 192 GiB Ultra-class host.

readiness.basis: Process start to HTTP model-list readiness. Observed single readiness times were 32-81 s. File-cache state is not controlled (purge needs privileges), so the two cases are recorded separately and never mixed.

long_lookup.basis: Observed single wall times were 268-272 s.

reference_relative.reference: pinned MLX-VLM 0.7.0rc0 (commit 6102cb4ad1a5b3cc38d8dc7e6cbe2aca395596cb) with MLX 0.32.2, Transformers 5.18.0.dev0 and Tokenizers 0.23.2; independent in-process language graph on the same pack bytes. Not the primary mlx_lm baseline, which cannot load qwen4_exp.
reference_relative.aggregation: median of three measured runs per cell within one server process; each AX arm runs in two independent server processes and keeps the lower-latency one (see measurement_amendment)
reference_relative.measurement_bias: AX is timed through an HTTP stream on loopback and the reference in process; the bound therefore disadvantages AX by the transport overhead and is not a speedup claim.

quality.basis: Every frozen-cohort item that AX fails must also fail on the independent reference runtime on the same pack revision; AX-specific failures are zero. Retained failures stay disclosed as checkpoint output limits and are never reclassified as passes.
quality.text_identity_required: product-default text equals explicit-direct text for all 105 items

mtp.measured_ratio_disclosure: Required MTP decoded at 0.90-0.93 of direct speed on 2026-10-05; it fails the MTP-P bounds (weighted >= 1.20x, median >= 1.10x) and is therefore not promoted.

delivery.fresh_cache: empty cache root, product downloader, pinned revision, no pre-existing files

disclosure: The memory, readiness and long-lookup bounds were set after observing the single measurements named above and are therefore descriptive guard rails, not independently pre-registered limits. The reference-relative, quality and identity bounds were frozen before any reference or product-default data were collected.

timing_host.basis: Timing, memory and readiness runs start only when system-wide CPU idle is at least 90% (3-second top sample) and the same bound must hold when they finish; the record is stored in each result. The desktop session keeps the load average near 3 on this 24-core host, so idle share is used. Added on 2026-10-05 before the final evidence collection; it tightens, and never relaxes, any earlier rule.

measurement_amendment.reason: After the bounds were frozen, repeated timing runs on this host showed time-varying background interference: the same binary and flags gave 2,048-token TTFT of 5.8 s and 4.3 s within one hour, while three consecutive clean processes agreed to better than 1% (4.26-4.29 s). A median over one process per arm therefore measured the interference, not the engine.
measurement_amendment.change: Each AX arm is measured in two independent server processes interleaved in time and keeps the one with the lower summed median TTFT; both are retained in the raw record and must emit identical tokens. No bound value changes.

target_amendment.change: standard host Mac Studio Ultra-class 192 GiB+ -> MacBook Pro M5 Max 128 GB; earlier gate results measured on the Ultra-class host do not certify the new standard and must be re-collected on it
